review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the dependency IndependentRadiusProjections.lean, which defines radiusPairProjection and radiusTripleProjection, and grepped the repo for uses of DistinctRadiusPairs and DistinctRadiusTriples. The only possible overlaps with Mathlib are the two abbreviations. DistinctRadiusPairs is {p : ι × ι // p.1 ≠ p.2}, which resembles the subtype of Set.offDiag univ. DistinctRadiusTriples is a three-way distinct-index subtype, which resembles injective maps Fin 3 → ι. These are small, local index types with direct projections and no API of their own. Switching to Set.offDiag or Function.Embedding would make the projection accesses and the distinctness hypotheses passed to radiusPairProjection_surjective and radiusTripleProjection_surjective more awkward. I found no duplicated substantive API or repeated conversions as a cost, so I am abstaining. The projection maps are built from Mathlib's PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv, ContinuousLinearMap.pi, proj and prod, so they are not competing concepts. The main theorem is a specialisation of the file's own exists_generic_radius_parameters, so it is not a concept duplicate.
